header.sector: AI accelerators, GPUs, custom silicon and their direct supply chain
header.title: Tighter China export controls accelerate Chinese labs' shift to domestic accelerators

s01_bottom_line.text: SemiAnalysis argues Jensen's exit removes Nvidia's biggest defender of China access, accelerating RASA-style export controls; cut off from Nvidia GPUs, Chinese labs are already moving to domestic accelerators (Z.ai/GLM-5, DeepSeek on Huawei Ascend, Meituan LongCat on Ascend 910B), harming Nvidia and benefiting Huawei.
The article argues escalating controls guarantee fewer chips produced and faster Chinese migration off Nvidia, which is already happening.

If RASA or similar passes and controls tighten, Nvidia loses China demand and the US open-source ecosystem loses Chinese contributions, while Huawei and domestic accelerators gain volume; the article does not quantify Nvidia's China revenue at risk.
